title: package.yaml
description: Package configuration. See spec/10-formats.md §10.2. Cross-file rules (the id matches the package's folder; every relies-on entry names a package that exists at that version; a base package registers only primary and secondary-official sources) are host validations, spec/14-implementation.md §14.2.

kind.description: What the package holds. See spec/02-layout.md §2.3.

relies-on.description: The packages this one describes, pinned. Every one MUST appear below this package in any stack that uses it (spec §2.2).

license.description: An SPDX license expression for the layer's own records (spec §2.10). That it parses as SPDX, and that a LicenseRef- has a LICENSE.md, are host validations (§14.2).

credit.description: The credit line the layer's makers ask for (spec §2.10).

allOf.description: A base package: its id is a bare fandom id and it relies on nothing. Only a base declares a calendar (spec §4.13).

calendar.description: The world's calendar (spec §4.13): iso, or a custom calendar of eras and optional months. The order rules for eras (only the first counts down, and it is not last; every era counting up except the last gives years) are host validations, §14.2.

notation.description: The calendar the work writes dates in: a Unicode BCP 47 calendar identifier, such as gregory or japanese. Only with calendar: iso (spec §4.13).

packageId.description: <fandom> for a base package, <fandom>/<package> otherwise, <fandom>/fanfic/<work> for a fan work.
